title: Lazy Evaluation and Early Exit
goal: Avoid unnecessary work by using lazy evaluation methods.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Morning: Option and Result

sections.text: Methods like `unwrap_or` and `ok_or` evaluate their arguments immediately. Passing a function call as an argument runs that code every time, even when the value exists.

sections.caption: fallback runs even when opt is Some.

sections.text: Companion methods ending in `_else` accept a closure instead. The compiler only runs the closure when the fallback is actually needed.

sections.caption: The closure runs only when opt is None.

sections.text: Use eager methods for plain literals. Use `_else` methods whenever creating the fallback allocates memory or performs work.

explanation: Avoid unnecessary work by using lazy evaluation methods.
